title: The Miners' Ghosts
text: Pale shapes still swing their picks at a seam of ore, as they have for a hundred years, the sound of their blows faint as a memory. The seam glitters. One of them turns, lamp-eyed and courteous, and asks for help with the last stretch.

options.label: Take up a pick and help them finish.

outcomes.text: The seam opens, and the ghosts lay down their picks for good, and thank you with their lamps going out.

options.label: Wait for them to break through, then take the ore.

outcomes.text: You get the ore. They turn their lamp-eyes on you, all of them, and do not look away.

options.label: The wisest asks them how they died.

outcomes.text: A cave-in. They show you where the next one will be, and the way around it.
